scenarios.name: Duplicate City ID
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /City IDs are strictly unique positive integers/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: City IDs are strictly unique positive integers

scenarios.name: Duplicate City Slug
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /City slugs are unique and follow prayer-times-in-\* format/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: City slugs are unique and follow prayer-times-in-* format

scenarios.name: Malformed City URL Path (Missing Trailing Slash)
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /City urlPath is unique and adheres to \/city\/\[slug\]\/ with trailing slash/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: City urlPath is unique and adheres to /city/[slug]/ with trailing slash

scenarios.name: Out-of-Bounds Latitude (+95.5°)
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /All cities possess valid WGS-84 coordinates within terrestrial bounds/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: All cities possess valid WGS-84 coordinates within terrestrial bounds

scenarios.name: Out-of-Bounds Longitude (-195.0°)
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /All cities possess valid WGS-84 coordinates within terrestrial bounds/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: All cities possess valid WGS-84 coordinates within terrestrial bounds

scenarios.name: Invalid IANA Timezone ("Mars/Curiosity")
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /All city timezones are valid IANA identifiers recognised by the JavaScript runtime/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: All city timezones are valid IANA identifiers recognised by the JavaScript runtime

scenarios.name: Unsupported Calculation Method ID (9999)
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /All cities map to recognized CalculationMethod IDs without unmapped fallbacks/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: All cities map to recognized CalculationMethod IDs without unmapped fallbacks

scenarios.name: Foreign Key Violation (Non-Existent Country ID 9999)
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /Foreign key integrity: Every city references an existing country ID/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: Foreign key integrity: Every city references an existing country ID

scenarios.name: Country Code Inconsistency (City has "US" but Country is "SA")
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /Country code consistency: city\.countryCode strictly matches parent country code/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: Country code consistency: city.countryCode strictly matches parent country code

scenarios.name: Country City-Count Synchronization Mismatch
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /Country declared totalCities synchronizes with actual city counts/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: Country declared totalCities synchronizes with actual city counts

scenarios.name: Legacy URL Manifest Regression (Missing High-Value City)
scenarios.expectedFailedCheck: /100% of legacy city and country URLs from GSC migration manifest exist in dataset/
scenarios.matchedFailedCheck: 100% of legacy city and country URLs from GSC migration manifest exist in dataset
